body:
A failed judgment retry could leave an old benchmark/viewer visible after invalidating verdicts. Remove both derived artifacts before judging and on failure while preserving execution inputs and raw diagnostics.

Existing regression reproduced the stale result; three focused fake-Claude CLI tests and independent Standards/Spec reviews pass. This is a source fix above #259; its incomplete judgment/viewer gates remain unchanged.
title: fix(eval): invalidate derived results before judging
